request.description:
Paginated order list.

Query params (all optional):
- page (default 1), limit (default 20)
- status: NEW | CONFIRMED | IN_PROGRESS | DELIVERED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED
  When omitted, COMPLETED orders are excluded.
- clientId: business client id, e.g. CL-2025-0004
- assignedToId: numeric user id of an assigned field technician
- search: matches orderId, productName or project name
- includeDeleted: 'true' also returns soft-deleted orders (each carrying isDeleted: true). Anything else keeps them hidden.

Required: projectId, clientId, productName, productGrade, quantity.
Optional: deliveryAddress, date, time, vendors[], technicians[], tmDetails[].

- projectId / clientId are business ids (PRJ-…, CL-…), not numeric ids.
- vendors[]: vendorId required per entry; a handler must belong to the given location, and the location to the vendor.
- technicians[]: [{ "userId": 38 }] or plain [38]; each must be a FIELD_TECHNICIAN.
- tmDetails[]: each entry needs only truckNo and qty. dispatchTime, arrivalTime, batchStartTime, batchEndTime, challanNo are optional and can be filled in later via PUT /orders/:orderId/tm/:tmId. TMs are numbered TM 01, TM 02 … by array position.

orderId (ORD-YYYY-0001), status NEW and deliveryStatus ASSIGNED are set by the server.

Full order with project, client, vendors, technicians, tmDetails and comments.
Pass includeDeleted=true to fetch a soft-deleted order instead of getting a 404.

request.description:
Order summary only — every field is optional, send just what changes.
Project, client, vendors and technicians are NOT editable here; use the vendor / technician endpoints below.
quantity is a string. deliveryAddress, date and time can be sent as null to clear them.

At least one of status / deliveryStatus is required.
- status: NEW | CONFIRMED | IN_PROGRESS | DELIVERED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED
- deliveryStatus: ASSIGNED | IN_TRANSIT | DELIVERED | COMPLETED

Setting status to COMPLETED generates the bill for that order automatically. The response then carries a `bill` object, or a `billError` string if billing could not run (e.g. no price configured) — the status change succeeds either way.

Once the bill exists, its detail page is where each TM gets its challan uploaded and gets accepted or rejected.
Soft delete (isDeleted = true).
message is required and must be non-blank. Posted as authorType ADMIN; the client and every assigned field technician are notified.
All active FIELD_TECHNICIAN users — use the returned id as userId when assigning.

Required: orderId (string), vendorId (integer).
Optional: vendorLocationId, vendorHandlerId (integers).
A handler is only valid together with its own location. The same vendor may be added twice from different plants; a repeat of the exact vendor + location pair returns 409.

Required: orderVendorId (the OrderVendor row id, from the vendor list), orderId.
Optional: vendorId, vendorLocationId, vendorHandlerId — omitted fields keep their current value, but the whole vendor/location/handler triple is re-validated together.
Soft delete of the order-vendor link.

Required: orderId (string), userId (integer, role FIELD_TECHNICIAN).
Re-assigning the same technician returns 409.

Swaps the technician on an existing assignment.
All three fields are required: orderTechnicianId (row id from the technician list), orderId, userId.
Soft delete of the order-technician link.

Required: truckNo, qty.
Optional: dispatchTime, arrivalTime, batchStartTime, batchEndTime, challanNo, status (ASSIGNED | IN_TRANSIT | DELIVERED | COMPLETED, defaults ASSIGNED).

tmNumber (TM 01, TM 02 …) is generated per order and never reuses a deleted number.

Orders only do TM CRUD. The challan file and the accept/reject are collected later, against the generated bill — see the Bills folder.
All non-deleted TMs on the order, oldest first. Use the returned id as tmId.

Every field optional — send only what changes; send null to clear a timing or challanNo.
tmNumber, challanUrl and approvalStatus cannot be changed here.

Soft delete.

TMs are delivery tracking only and do not affect billing.

Manual fallback. Orders are billed AUTOMATICALLY the moment they are set to COMPLETED via PUT /orders/:orderId/status — use this only for a COMPLETED order that has no bill yet (e.g. billing was skipped because no price was configured).

Required: orderId.
Optional: rate (numeric, >= 0) — overrides the project pricing for that product + grade; without it a ProjectProduct price must exist. dueDate (date string).

quantity comes from the ORDER's quantity field, amount = quantity × rate, status starts at PENDING, billNo is BILL-YYYY-0001.

400 when the order is not COMPLETED, or its quantity does not parse as a positive number; 409 when the order already has a bill.

Query params (all optional):
- page (default 1), limit (default 20)
- status: PENDING | SENT | PAID | OVERDUE | CANCELLED
- clientId: business client id, e.g. CL-2025-0004
- search: matches billNo, order id or client company name
404 if the order has no bill yet.
Bill page payload: billDetails, fieldTechnicians, tmDetails and activityLog.

formdata.description: PDF or image of the challan

request.description:
multipart/form-data with a single file field named `challan`.
Allowed: .pdf .jpg .jpeg .png, max 10MB.
Do NOT set Content-Type manually — Postman adds the boundary.

Collected against a generated bill: the bill detail page lists the order's TMs and this is the '+ Add challan' action on each one. Sets challanUrl on the TM, viewable at {{base_url}}<challanUrl> ('View challan'). Re-uploading replaces it.

tmId comes from the bill payload's tmDetails[].id.

Required: approvalStatus (PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED).
rejectionReason required and non-blank when REJECTED; cleared otherwise. approvedAt is stamped on ACCEPTED.

Reviewed against a generated bill — this is the Accepted/Rejected badge on each TM of the bill detail page. Purely a record: rejecting a TM does NOT reduce the billed amount.

tmId comes from the bill payload's tmDetails[].id.

Required: billNo.
Optional: rate (numeric, >= 0), dueDate (send null to clear), recalculate (boolean).

recalculate: true re-reads the order's quantity; amount is always recomputed as quantity × rate.
409 when the bill is PAID or CANCELLED — those are locked.

Both fields required. status: PENDING | SENT | PAID | OVERDUE | CANCELLED.
paidAt is stamped on the first move to PAID and cleared when moving away from PAID. SENT / PAID / OVERDUE notify the client.
